body: Not sure if it's directly involved, but the error mentions jarjar and git bisect points to 823091f7516abf7d854021edc765daf1467f1647 as the culprit, so assigning to @lberki
Actually, that can't be the root cause, it's just where the symptom shows up. Sigh, continuing to search.
Looks like the issue is here: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/src/main/cpp/blaze_util_windows.cc#L1059

> // Builds a shorter output base dir name for Windows.

IMO having that special behavior _only_ for Windows is guaranteed to break thinks further down the line when devs are not using Windows as their primary platform.

issue.body:
### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

A few times a day, Bazel seems to corrupt itself.

    bazel shutdown

Error is:

    Error: corrupt installation: file 'C:\Users\A5336~1.BER\AppData\Local\Temp\_bazel_a.bergmeier\install\ef18c8a0c4758f558e9141b77d899cfd\_embedded_binaries\build-runfiles.exe' missing. Please remove 'C:\Users\A5336~1.BER\AppData\Local\Temp\_bazel_a.bergmeier\install\ef18c8a0c4758f558e9141b77d899cfd' and try again.

Aside from any corruption, this is annoying because this means I have to manually kill the Server with Process Explorer.
So `shutdown` really should not depend on anything superfluous.
Still - should not corrupt itself.

### Environment info
* Operating System: Windows 10


* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`): 855fbe9ee447b7b37fd8c73dbc047d69b7ceffcf

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web? (e.g. GitHub issues, email threads in the [bazel-discuss@googlegroups.com](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bazel-discuss) archive)
Seems to have happened in the past but fixed (for non-win): #471

### Anything else, information or logs or outputs that would be helpful?
Removing the install fixes it.
